_comment: Generated by the independent reference CPM (packages/scheduler/tests/oracle/reference_cpm.py), NOT by either engine (#3987). case_* are planning networks; progress_* carry progress, a data date, SNETs and per-task calendars (#4633); fraction_* are progress networks whose live tasks carry fractional, 100*k/n and one-ULP-off percents (#5034); wide_* are progress networks drawn from the live near/far mixture, far data dates, long tasks and shutdowns and a 25-task profile included (#4914); named_* are hand-built shapes the random draw rarely reaches (#4785). Regenerate with REGEN_ORACLE_CORPUS=1 pytest packages/scheduler/tests/test_cpm_oracle.py -k corpus
